renderTool: tools/render-one-reconstruction.mjs through the shared GPU mutex
scope: Scene03 upper hip roof, front dormer gable, eave closure and its two narrow frieze strips only.
changes: Upper hip width reduced from 15.0 to 13.6 m, eave raised from 14.4 to 15.4 m, retaining the 19.6 m main ridge and fixed camera/site.
Front gable crown lowered from 19.35 to 18.62 m and half-width reduced from 3.85 to 3.45 m. A smaller closed recessed dark timber diaphragm replaces the large bright flat triangle.
The decorative roof loft joins the actual hip weather surface; curved bedding, 18 mm pan/cover tiles, short eave tails and a continuous closed fascia establish real thickness.
The previous curved upper timber parts remain, with their receiver beam and upper assembly moved to meet the new roof underside. The first candidate’s bare gap-fillers are removed.
Two white upper-storey strips are reduced from 0.65 to 0.25 m and use recessed grey fields.
A closed lobed ceramic family-medallion crest uses only the former kit’s backing. Eyes and teeth are omitted; a physical ceramic pedestal seats the retained finial.
remainingDifferences: The upper-storey wall panels, beam spacing and repeated timber faces remain more regular and exposed than the original carved frieze.
Roof corner/shoulder projection retains local residuals; the analytical anchor measurements do not establish photographic fidelity.
The gable carving, crest shape, ceramic colour variation and gilded wear remain simplified.
Low-camera light, stone, vegetation and reflections remain visibly synthetic and were outside this roof correction.
